title: Estimating Degrading Dimensions Efficiently
text:
Suppose a representation contains (D) dimensions. Some dimensions improve performance, while others degrade performance.
Leave-one-out evaluation requires approximately (D) experiments, which becomes expensive when (D) is large.

title: Estimating Degrading Dimensions Efficiently
text:
Research question
Can we identify degrading dimensions using a much smaller number of uniformly designed group ablations?

title: Estimating Degrading Dimensions Efficiently
text:
Current idea
Construct a binary experiment matrix
[ Z {0,1}^{T D}, ]
where every experiment removes exactly (m) dimensions and every dimension appears approximately equally often.

title: Estimating Degrading Dimensions Efficiently
text:
Potential method
Estimate the dimension effects using Elastic Net:
[ = _{} |y-Z|_2^2 +_1||_1 +_2||_2^2. ]

title: Estimating Degrading Dimensions Efficiently
text:
Open questions

How many experiments are required?
How should the experiment matrix be constructed?
How robust is the estimate under interaction effects?
How should degrading dimensions be validated?
